_doc: GENERIC verification ladder + stamping for GENERATOR workflows (TritorX, KernelAgent, ...) that have no performance signal -- the routed quantity is VERIFICATION DEPTH, not a profiler. Same skeleton as profiler_registry.json: a ladder tried in order, each rung gated by host capability, confidence stamped by method (never by the agent). evidence values reuse the existing evidence_schema EVIDENCE enum (correctness/runtime/compile/llm_inferred) -- no new enum needed.

reference_test._doc: run the candidate against a reference op, numerical comparison (allclose/MAA). deepest, most trusted.

smoke_test._doc: compile + run on sample inputs; check shapes/finiteness/no-crash, no reference comparison.

compile_lint._doc: compile + lint only; no execution. cheap prune signal.

_note_need: prune intentionally skips reference_test/smoke_test -- do not pay execution cost during early pruning; confirm walks the full ladder to the deepest method the host supports.
